recentItems.title: BRICS cooperation: Shared prosperity for half of world's population
recentItems.description:
What does BRICS cooperation mean for ordinary people?
Twenty years on, the mechanism continues to expand trade, improve connectivity and create new opportunities for development across the Global South.
From New Delhi, we ask people on the ground what BRICS cooperation really means to them -- and what they expect as China prepares to assume the BRICS presidency next year. #BRICS2026 #GlobalSouth #NewDelhi #India

recentItems.title: CIFTIS 2026 | Where education meets int'l cooperation & smart innovation
recentItems.description: The Education Services Section of the 2026 CIFTIS is being held at Beijing's Shougang Park. It highlights international education cooperation and smart education innovation through various showcases and exhibits including "Study Beijing," smart labs, data-driven student profiles and AI-assisted rope-skipping tests. #CIFTIS

recentItems.title: What BRICS family saw at CIFIT: markets, investment and new partnerships
recentItems.description:
What is the BRICS family looking for in China? And where are the biggest opportunities?
At the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade (CIFIT) in east China's coastal city Xiamen, CIFIT participants from Brazil, South Africa, Indonesia, Uganda and Thailand had a clear answer: bigger markets, investment, technology, supply chains and new business partnerships.

recentItems.title: On-Site in New Delhi | BRICS 2027, Eyes on China
recentItems.description:
#China will take over the #BRICS presidency in 2027 and host the bloc's next leaders' summit.
And in #NewDelhi, expectations are already building.
Participants at this year's BRICS summit say they want to see in China a more influential, innovative and inclusive BRICS, with deeper cooperation and a stronger voice for all members.
Hear from on-site reports in New Delhi.
